name: Southeast Face (Standard Route)
approach: Park at the Reflection Lakes pullouts on Stevens Canyon Road (or, when the road is snowed in, at the year-round Narada Falls lot). Take the signed Pinnacle Peak Trail from the south side of the road; it climbs steadily through forest and subalpine meadow for about 1.3 miles and 1,050 ft of gain to the 5,920-ft saddle just south of Pinnacle Peak. From the saddle, instead of continuing up Pinnacle, traverse climber's-left (east) across Pinnacle's south-facing scree/boulder field, staying around 6,000-6,200 ft, to the col between Pinnacle and Castle — roughly another half mile of cross-country travel to the base of Castle's south/southeast side. Mount Rainier National Park's Plummer Peak Fire closure, effective August 31, 2026 until further notice (fire page updated September 21, 2026), closes the Butter Creek Research Natural Area south of the Pinnacle Peak Trail to the park boundary. On the park's closure map its edge runs along the crest at The Castle, so Castle's south side and the east end of this traverse are inside it and closed while it stands; the Pinnacle Peak Trail, Pinnacle Saddle and Stevens Canyon Road are open.
beta: From the Pinnacle Saddle Trailhead at Reflection Lakes, hike the Pinnacle Peak Trail to the ~5,920-ft saddle south of Pinnacle Peak, then leave the trail and contour east across Pinnacle's south-face scree/talus (roughly 6,000-6,200 ft) to the Castle-Pinnacle col. From the col, scramble onto Castle's south rib, make a short class-3 traverse onto the east flank, and follow the obvious crack-chimney system (easy 5th class; some parties call this the East Face Chimney Route) up and right to a notch beside a natural rock horn. A brief, exposed class 3-4 scramble along the summit crest leads to the true (northernmost) summit block. Many parties fix a handline or belay the chimney pitch and always rappel or downclimb it on the return.

waypoints.name: Pinnacle Peak Trailhead (Reflection Lakes, Stevens Canyon Road)
waypoints.note: Shared trailhead for Pinnacle Peak, Plummer Peak, and The Castle; hike about 1.3 miles up Pinnacle Peak Trail then contour south/east across scree below Pinnacle's summit to reach The Castle's SE side.
waypoints.directions: From Ashford, follow SR 706 east through the Nisqually Entrance and drive about 15 miles toward Paradise to the Stevens Canyon Road junction; turn right and drive 1.5 miles to the Reflection Lakes parking. From the east, take Stevens Canyon Road west about 18 miles from SR 123. The trail starts on the south side of the road. A park entrance pass is required; when Stevens Canyon Road is snowed in, start from the Narada Falls lot.

waypoints.name: The Castle summit (true/northernmost ridge)
waypoints.directions: Take the Pinnacle Peak Trail 1.3 miles and about 1,050 ft to Pinnacle Saddle. Leave the trail and contour east across Pinnacle's south-face scree at 6,000-6,200 ft, about half a mile, to the Pinnacle-Castle col. Scramble onto the south rib, traverse class 3 onto the east flank, climb the crack-chimney to a notch beside a rock horn, then scramble the exposed crest north to the true summit.
